global_caption: The video consists of 5 shots and presents a realistic-style geological observation of a volcanic island. The overall visual tone is dominated by a neutral color palette, using natural lighting primarily, supplemented by red reflections from the eruption. The camera movement evolves gradually from calm observation to tense tracking. The
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a hard cut to a wide eye-level composition. Foreground features slightly swaying shrubs and tree trunks; midground shows an elderly woman standing alone at the edge of a forest at the mountain base; background faintly reveals the outline of the volcano. The depth of the forest creates leading lines, while light mist and dust enhance spatial layers. Natural light spreads evenly, and scattered leaves on the ground vibrate subtly.
shot2: Shot 2 connects via a hard cut to a wide overhead-to-eye-level tracking shot. The distant crater gradually comes into focus, emitting swirling black smoke and intermittent red glows. Natural light remains dominant, but sky brightness is dimmed by smoke, and red reflections begin to appear along rock edges. The camera steadily tracks her path and slightly tilts upward at the end of the sentence, fully framing the crater.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via a hard cut to a close-up to near-extreme close-up eye-level shot. Her face dominates the frame. Slight air distortion caused by heat waves appears in the foreground, while the background blurs into churning molten lava and glowing fissures. Shallow depth of field keeps focus tightly on her wrinkled face, subtle eye twitching, and skin texture illuminated by red light. Lighting continues the dual tone of natural light and volcanic red glow, with red light sweeping across one side of her face, enhancing the sense of imminent danger. She instinctively steps back half a step, her gaze crossing over the lens toward the crack below, urgently warning “别靠近裂口”.
shot4: Shot 4 connects via a hard cut to a medium eye-level tracking pan shot. The character rapidly retreats from left to right across a black volcanic wasteland. Rough, charred rocks pass in the foreground, while a bright river of lava flows down scorched earth in the midground. Smoke continues to rise from the lower slopes in the background. Overall lighting remains unchanged—natural daylight suppresses the vast gray-black terrain, while red-orange reflections from the lava’s heat flicker across the ground and the edges of her clothing. She turns her head to observe while quickly retreating, her hem fluttering in the hot wind, her steps clearly faster. The camera continuously pans with a slight handheld feel, accurately recording changes in speed and terrain elevation.
shot5: Shot 5 connects via a fade-in transition to a long-medium eye-level rear view composition. The character stands before a black rocky shoreline, facing away from the camera, forming a stable vertical center. The foreground features wet rocks and rolling seawater, while in the background, lava pours into the sea, rising in large plumes of white steam and turbulent vapor. The horizon and steam clouds create an open layered depth. The color tone remains predominantly neutral cool gray, with only the point where lava meets water bursting into brighter orange-red. High-temperature steam glows softly at the backlit edges. The camera first slowly pushes in on her back and gesture, then slightly tilts upward to include the steam and sky, completing a continuous observational record from surface activity to lava entering the sea.
